assets.name: 月面基地
assets.source: Built-in image_gen, original asset generated for this project
assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent game-map asset, derived from the pixel language of the reference cosmos image. It must be an unmistakably COARSE LOW-RES 16-bit pixel sprite, large square pixel clusters, hard stair-step outlines, flat limited palette navy/royal blue/cyan/ivory/lunar lavender/gold. No smooth gradients, no vector edges, no antialias, no tiny painterly detail. Draw a small MOON BASE landing location: a blue-glass observatory dome on a thick grey-lavender lunar rock island, short antenna, TWO modest solar panels, and a clearly visible EMPTY octagonal landing pad at the front center. Isometric 3/4 slightly top-down view. Transparent RGBA outside the island. Composition on a square canvas: object spans 85% width, 75% height; the front landing pad center precisely at 50% x, 72% y. Nothing extends outside canvas. This image will be shown only about 190px wide, so keep large chunky pixels and a very simple readable silhouette, equivalent to a hand-painted 96x96 pixel asset enlarged by nearest neighbor. No text, no letters, no numerals, no UI, no glowing selection ring, no background, no stars. Only this ONE facility.
assets.export: Full canvas; no crop; NEAREST resize; lossless WebP; generated alpha preserved
